description: This file defines the 'Request' class within the OpenCart system library, providing methods to access and sanitize HTTP request data such as GET, POST, COOKIE, FILES, and SERVER variables.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A class that encapsulates HTTP request data, providing sanitization and access methods for request variables.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Request object by sanitizing global PHP request variables ($_GET, $_POST, $_COOKIE, $_FILES, $_SERVER).

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Recursively sanitizes input data by trimming and converting special characters to HTML entities to prevent XSS attacks.
